caption.en: Hand-blown glass study of a mandrill—crimson, cobalt, and amber pigments suspended within clear sculpted fur catching prismatic light.
caption.zh: 以吹製琉璃質感詮釋山魈，將朱紅、鈷藍與琥珀色澤封存於透明流線毛紋之間，在林間折出細微虹光。

alt.en: Translucent hand-blown glass sculpture of a mandrill with red nose, golden beard, and swirling clear glass fur
alt.zh: 透明吹製琉璃山魈雕塑，具紅色鼻樑、金色鬍鬚與流線透明玻璃毛紋
